entry_points.text: File map delegates installing dummy ops on error; throttle wakes only with waiters; poison unmap always busy; shrinker name persists with oom on fail and free clears; io prep decrypts then generic marking frame remap; map count atomic.
Alloc forbids nmi and hard irq, rounds size, grows ordered maps, adds guard unless off, sleeps only when blocking allowed.
Free removes tracked range checking descriptor then frees; vmalloc test strips tags checking bounds; module-or-vmalloc accepts module interval if present else vmalloc check.

exports.text: File and anon interval trees provide insertion with maxima upkeep and rebalance, removal by offsets or chain, first and next overlap iteration, and anon bound verification warning on cached mismatch.
Lookup maps address to owning descriptor via vmap search with miss as absence; reservation builds descriptor with size alignment guard NUMA caller then binds vmap area or releases on failure.

Ioremap validates and maps with release on failure; range map needs exact marked span; vmap installs non-executable then flushes with sanitizer accounting; remap checks containment and copy coverage; constant free skips read-only data.

hazards.text: Once warning reports truth unless no-warn; spin try banned in nmi or hard irq on rt and nmi on up; nommu release faults; no-flush walk may sleep syncing once when needed.

Populated leaf with valid frame dumps then traps, overlap warns and refuses, bad length warns; empty preload tries non-sleeping alloc failing to purge retry; bad fit or outside rejected, empty tree degrades to insert.
Detached unlink warns unchanged; pool mismatch warns once unconsumed; bad node encode or decode warns falling back neutral.

invariants.text: Move init sets old end as start plus length; anon get bumps refcount; page marking steps framewise; walk end fast-paths one page else clamps offset-derived address; mlock bars special droppable direct hugetlb and gate areas.

Disabled or empty helpers: remote mlock drain, dirty flush and page accept do nothing; reclaim reports zero and no node, enabled on any zone write unmap bit; disabled shrinker debug succeeds emptily with detach id minus one.

Notifying young clear unions local and notifier over same span for batch and huge middle, with or without flush; without notifier support aliases plain; huge middle needs alignment, atomic clear, flush only when young seen.

Install splits interval per table boundary trying huge leaf then descending, advancing phys base, stopping on error; alloc-track creates missing child recording level mask; huge needs threshold, arch ok, exact coverage and alignments.

Busy shards by address over zone size modulo nodes with wrap lookup; containment walks left or right; free search takes lowest aligned fit via subtree maxima with overflow-safe checks; insert keeps disjoint tree plus sorted list.

Fit is non-fit full left right or interior; free merges exact successor then predecessor releasing absorbed else links; each node caches max of self and children propagated to root with debug recompute check.

Pools index by rounded pages below limit else bypass; node id via dense array with warn fallback, flags reserve zero shifting valid by a byte; node alloc needs full interval with many nodes picking cpu modulo with exact aligned match.
Block shard is block size modulo cpus with skip on impossible, index from vmalloc base; lazy purge releases sanitizer for vmalloc or module entries with rescheduling then range release with flush.

locks.text: Anon write try takes root semaphore without sleep; conditional rmap unlock drops file write lock clearing hide only when requested with non-anon check; swap prep links globally under list lock once via double-checked emptiness.
Busy lookup or insert holds owning node lock briefly; free carve preloads then drops with reschedule outside; huge over present entry needs best-effort initial-space read lock, abandoning on failure.

Busy removal under start node lock, free merge under global lock; lazy under lazy lock, pools under pool lock, purge under purge mutex after detach; frag scan under read guard then block and queue locks; split preload cmpxchgs spare.

state_machines.text: Close runs hook once then dummy ops blocking later; alloc validates fast-paths carves inserts, blocking retries after purge then notifier then warns and fails, nonblocking fails at once.
Carve by fit: full removes and frees, left advances start, right retreats end, interior splits keeping left remainder and advancing original, partial refreshes maxima and links remainder.

Free enters lazy counting pages scheduling drain past threshold; purge detaches flushes then pools or reclaims; decay drops all or quarter via temp tree; frag purges on full fragmented capacity with fencing detach and release.

structs.text: Move control bundles areas old and new ranges length and rmap and stack flags; area ops are split merge remap fork; batch spare is bitwise int; poison filter is page to int; migration target holds node mask alloc and reason.
Compaction holds lists counts bases zone totals hints params mode and flags; capture keeps zone type order and page; anon rmap keys by derived start last caching bounds with removal by chain.
Vmap record has start end descriptor link node flags and list plus max free; link and unlink update tree and list together clearing node, augmented forms keep maxima.
Per node has busy and lazy trees locks, sized queues lengths pool locks, purge list work and flags; blocks have free dirty interval cpu lock links and area with per-cpu queues and index.

Reclaim mask unions reclaim highmem io fs and retry flags; boot is alloc minus reclaim io fs; constraint is hardwall plus single node; slab bug is DMA32 highmem plus outside bits; retries sixteen; node mode zero disabled.

Entirely mapped 0x800000 with pages mapped one less; filter low bit disallowed; five folio bits zero to four for dirty handling; poison magic HWPS; pin flags bits sixteen to twenty-two with union mask.
VMALLOC_START END bound predicates and node alloc; PAGE_SIZE SHIFT convert bytes pages; BITS_PER_BYTE splits flags and node id; VMAP bits size and threshold rule blocks and purge.
